scope: All 14 screenshots visually inspected. Account section only. Scores describe visible presentation; keyboard behavior, semantics, actual hit areas, and measured contrast were not tested.
verdict: After improves warning visibility, quota labeling, and control recognition. Refine narrow header height, desktop control presentation, and stale-summary alignment while retaining the dark palette and explicit warning text.

findings.finding: The isolated 'Remaining' heading does not identify what the prominent account percentages measure.
findings.fix: Name the quantity 'Weekly quota remaining', as After does.

findings.finding: 'Expand All' resembles neighboring metadata rather than a distinct control.
findings.fix: Give it a bounded dark button surface and padding, as After does.

findings.finding: 'Expand All' is recognizable but its visible button remains shallow.
findings.fix: Increase its vertical padding modestly while keeping it in the header row.

findings.finding: The first disclosure indicator and final account percentage sit against the crop's outer edges.
findings.fix: Provide a small consistent inline inset inside the account section for disclosure indicators and rightmost values.

findings.finding: Named warning rows expose the 0% credits and 14% short-term limit; 'Low' communicates warning meaning alongside amber.
'Remaining' leaves the three bold percentages insufficiently identified.
findings.fix: Use the explicit weekly-quota heading shown in After.

findings.finding: 'Expand All' has little visual separation from the loaded and eligible counts.
findings.fix: Use a padded, bounded button surface.

findings.finding: The bounded 'Expand All' control remains visually shallow.
findings.fix: Increase its vertical padding without adding another header line.

findings.finding: The first disclosure indicator and third account's percentage have almost no outer breathing room.
findings.fix: Add a small internal inset at both ends of the account section.

findings.finding: All three accounts remain readable in columns, and both warning labels fit without wrapping.
'Remaining' does not explain the account percentages, while the count sentence splits before 'eligible'.
findings.fix: Separate the section title from the counts and explicitly label weekly quota.

findings.finding: Both the count sentence and 'Expand All' wrap in the narrow header.
findings.fix: Keep 'Expand All' on one line and give the title and counts a deliberate two-line arrangement.

findings.finding: The full weekly-quota heading occupies a separate third header line, increasing space before the first account.
findings.fix: Use 'Weekly quota left' and align it opposite the counts on the second line, retaining the one-line button.

findings.finding: Right-aligned percentages touch the section's right edge, while disclosure indicators hug the left edge.
findings.fix: Inset both ends consistently without reducing the space reserved for account names.

findings.finding: The larger visible button is easy to distinguish, and both warning rows retain explicit 'Low' labels.
The header's generic 'Remaining' label gives less context than the row's specific 'Weekly quota unavailable' message.
findings.fix: Identify weekly quota in the header while retaining the explicit unavailable message.

findings.finding: The header wraps both the count sentence and button label before the already tall account rows.
findings.fix: Keep the button label on one line and group title and counts deliberately.

findings.finding: The first account's percentage and disclosure indicator sit midway through its multiline name, unlike the single-line account summaries.
findings.fix: Align the indicator and percentage with the first line of the account name, as After does.

findings.finding: The separate weekly-quota heading adds a third header line above the multiline account.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'Weekly quota left' and place it opposite the counts on the second line.

findings.finding: Percentages and the unavailable dash have almost no right inset.
findings.fix: Add a small internal right gutter while preserving the long name's full wrapping.

findings.finding: The long name remains complete. 'Weekly quota unavailable' and the separately named 5-hour warning remain distinguishable.
The bold account percentages sit beneath an underspecified 'Remaining' heading.
findings.fix: Identify weekly quota explicitly in the heading.

findings.finding: Account 3's standalone 'Unavailable' message leaves the unavailable quantity implicit.
findings.fix: Use 'Weekly quota unavailable' beside the existing dash, matching the clearer wording visible in the long-narrow state.

findings.finding: 'Expand All' resembles metadata.
findings.fix: Give the control a bounded surface and padding.

findings.finding: Account 3's disclosure indicator and dash are vertically centered across its two-line summary, unlike the neighboring accounts.
findings.fix: Align the indicator, name, and dash on the first line, as After does.

findings.finding: The visible 'Expand All' button remains shallow.
findings.fix: Increase its vertical padding modestly.

findings.finding: Account 3's dash sits against the right edge, and the first disclosure indicator hugs the left.
findings.fix: Add consistent internal inline padding to the account section.

findings.finding: 'Remaining' does not identify the quota represented by the bold percentages.
findings.fix: Use an explicit weekly-quota heading.

findings.finding: Account 3's 'Stale · Last observed' line wraps the timestamp, making its summary substantially denser than its neighbors.
findings.fix: Keep one stale label beside the value and place the observation timestamp on a separate metadata line.

findings.finding: 'Stale' appears both before the observation timestamp and below the percentage.
findings.fix: Retain one clear stale label associated with the percentage, as After does.

findings.finding: Account 3's disclosure indicator sits beside its metadata rather than its name.
findings.fix: Align the disclosure indicator with the account-name line.

findings.finding: 'Expand All' is visually similar to the counts.
findings.fix: Use a bounded button surface with padding.

findings.finding: Account 3's name and disclosure indicator sit lower than the neighboring account names and its own 82.8% value.
findings.fix: Top-align Account 3's indicator, name, and percentage on one summary line; keep 'Stale' beneath the percentage and the observation timestamp below.
findings.regression: Layout falls from 8 to 7: Before kept Account 3's name approximately aligned with the neighboring names; After visibly lowers it while leaving its percentage on the upper baseline.

findings.finding: 'Expand All' has a clearer surface but remains visually shallow.
findings.fix: Increase its vertical padding modestly.

findings.finding: Account 3's percentage and 'Stale' label sit against the right edge.
findings.fix: Add a small right inset shared by the percentage and its status label.

findings.finding: The observation and forecast metadata starts higher in Accounts 2 and 3 than in Account 1, with little separation from the quota rows.
findings.fix: Align the metadata sections across columns and introduce a subtle divider, as After does.

findings.finding: The 0% credits and 14% 5-hour limit use amber without explicitly naming their warning state; the header also says only 'Remaining'.
findings.fix: Add 'Low' to the affected metric labels and identify weekly quota in the header, preserving the amber values.

findings.finding: The reset timestamps beneath quota rows are noticeably smaller than neighboring labels and other timestamp values.
findings.fix: Raise reset timestamps to the size used by the other secondary metadata, retaining their subdued colour and close association with each quota.

findings.finding: 'Collapse All' looks like header metadata.
findings.fix: Give it a bounded surface and padding.

findings.finding: 'Collapse All' is recognizable but its visible button remains shallow.
findings.fix: Increase its vertical padding modestly while retaining its position in the header.

findings.finding: Aligned metadata dividers improve scanning, and explicit 'Low' labels preserve warning meaning beyond colour.
